status: AT→AU intended transition and initial→frozen pre-pin bridge approved. Root may promote the reviewed pre-pin candidate; final rebuilt release validation remains required.
scope: Three equipment carriers gain generic tie/M2 slots; accessory gains a shifted common mechanical stack interface. Mini and its two connector reserves move exactly 3 mm along local −Y. Two printed horn adapters remain one common print, now with a continuous radial slot. The selected mixed metal horns use four 5 mm screws at the intended attachment radii and flat front seat. Gear, output shaft, propulsion frame, motor, servo, rail and optical geometry and all native controls remain unchanged. Optional power assembly stays separate from the main inventory.

review_provenance.authorship: Reviewer authored the carrier fastening/structural host changes. Horn and optional-power changes were authored by other agents. This is cross-review plus a complete native/BRep delta capture, not a wholly author-independent review of every changed carrier.
review_provenance.complementary_review: Power-module author independently detected the initial opposite-foot screw/rail clash. Root and power-module author reviewed the final datum/Mini relocation and whole-assembly option screening. The retained source-native containment/clearance regressions independently exercise the implemented bounds.

limits: Review establishes declared CAD deltas, not manufactured fit, strength, thermal/current margin, RF or flight qualification. Optical tray intentionally keeps its uninterrupted adhesive surface. Accessory is a mechanical/power host, not an optical host. Optional power installation choices must follow their separate screen and cannot share an occupied optical host.
remaining_before_final_release: Root promotes the reviewed pre-pin candidate and binds its immutable hash in fixture configuration.
After promotion and final source rebuild, require full saved-CAD validation, strict fixture comparison, artifact/export checks and appropriate native regression coverage.
initial_candidate_validation_limit: Geometric/service checks were satisfactory, but source/BOM/manifest identity checks correctly failed after source changes; the failed report is preserved and must not be cited as a full validation pass.
